purpose: Intermediate review and unmodified JSON evidence subset for the first candidate iOS CI artifact. Not a release or an original Windows Phone parity certification.

provenance.head: 413b4bff45efa83c7afc48c51a0001857c80d0e4
provenance.head_run_job_artifact_binding_source: Parent task supplied the GitHub artifact provenance; this review independently verified the supplied ZIP digest and the inspected/copied member bytes.

method.image_review: Viewed the original full-size PNGs marked full_image_visually_inspected. Independently decoded all eight listed originals to RGBA and derived each navigation crop from recorded button geometry and render scale. No PNG was changed or copied.
method.crop_coordinates: LTRB pixels, right and bottom exclusive; physical coordinates from native point bounds multiplied by render_scaling.
method.row_hash: SHA-256 of row-major raw RGBA bytes.
method.bright_pixel_test: Every RGB channel >100 and alpha ==255, counted within each recorded navigation button rectangle.

observations.bottom_gray_strip: The 68-pixel strip below the navigation row corresponds to the recorded 34-point UIKit bottom safe area; it is not a missing navigation row.
observations.embedding: Original captures include the native iOS top status area above the emulated shell status row.
observations.blank_navigation_assessment: The historical blank-icon interpretation was retracted in the existing correction; the current original pixels support that correction.
observations.visible_content: Start tiles, Settings device-services leaf, People device-contact list/search/app bar, and Search page render in the inspected original frames.

navigation_provenance.driver_liveness_boundary: launch-driver JSON records shell kill -0 of the simctl launch child; native application identity is taken from the fresh observation native fields.

scope_qualifications: Results belong to candidate head 413b4bff45efa83c7afc48c51a0001857c80d0e4 and the identified iOS Simulator artifact; they do not qualify subsequent candidate revisions.
Settings capture opens the device-services leaf and mounts DeviceSettingsRoot. It does not exercise the newly retained Settings root Pivot.
People capture opens device contacts. It does not establish every People section, contact-detail layout or Pivot gesture.
Static Start and restored-Start frames do not qualify Start-to-All-Apps transition motion, timing or held-drag behavior.
This run provides no visual qualification of the newly implemented Action Center mixed-store gestures or animated progress dots.
Navigation results establish the four recorded Search, Back, Search and Start taps with fresh route observations, not every lifecycle or input path.
Device checks are simulator-only. Physical brightness requires device qualification; observed network path availability is not Internet reachability. No calls or messages were sent.
No original Windows Phone reference-device comparison was performed. These captures do not establish pixel parity, OS completeness, hardware feature equivalence, or original Cortana behavior.
No PNG or xcresult binary data is duplicated in the intermediate evidence subset. All copied JSON files retain their original bytes.

artifact_phase_statement.text: UIKit mounting, six native activations, four real navigation taps, Contacts CRUD and simulator hardware limits passed.
